bio: Congratulations and welcome to Harvard Class of 2029! I transitioned to Cambridge from Jamaica, New York and my family hails from Jamaica, W.I. so Jamaica both ways. I am a graduate of the College and the Graduate School of Education, where I honed interests at the intersection of education, law and equity. I consider it a great blessing to now serve in the Math Department, teaching and providing support to students in calculus courses. I greatly look forward to learning and growing with you! :-) Community Yards Ivy Yard Area Proctors Role Proctors
